**Purpose**: Review clarity, completeness, consistency and acceptance readiness of authentication/session requirements before task generation and peer review.

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [contracts.md](../contracts.md)

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` from the current confirmed feature context. Standard depth; reviewer audience before implementation. Focus: credential/session lifecycle and revocation/concurrency, with identity/privacy integration boundaries. **Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark `[x]` only after the reviewer determines the written requirement criterion is satisfied.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are initial USER permissions consistent with self-profile/address ownership and authentication-only limited-profile viewing? [Consistency, Spec FR-017, Spec FR-021, Contracts Confirmed bootstrap configuration] **Review evidence**: The user confirmed permission plus ownership. spec.md FR-017 / Permission and Ownership Decision and contracts.md Confirmed authority and ownership enforcement now require exact hasAuthority checks; HTTP/domain-service contracts, plan, research and quickstart agree. Missing authority is 403; authority never bypasses ownership; authorized foreign/missing addresses remain 404; limited-public-profile viewing is authentication-only.
- [x] CHK011 Are all statements about email replacement consistent with immediate loss of old-address login and provisional trust of only the replacement? - Spec refers to ../spec.md, Plan to ../plan.md, Contracts to ../contracts.md, HTTP to ../contracts/http.md, Transactions to ../contracts/transactions.md and Data Model to ../data-model.md. Section names/FR/SC identifiers provide traceability.

## Historical Review Disposition Before Clarification (2026-10-26)

Reviewed at the user's request against spec.md, contracts.md, plan.md, data-model.md, research.md, quickstart.md and all three detailed contracts. **37/38 requirements-quality criteria satisfied; CHK010 remains open.** Inline evidence records why each checked item passes. No requirement or security policy has been changed to resolve the finding implicitly.

CHK010 requires one consistent rule for an authenticated ACTIVE owner whose current MANAGE_USER_PROFILE or MANAGE_ADDRESS permission is absent: either require the corresponding permission and document the denial as an intentional change to the prior policy, or retain authentication-plus-ownership access and remove contradictory permission-gate requirements. Limited-public-profile viewing remains authentication-only in either case. This is a requirements consistency finding, not a claim of a runtime defect.

Source inventory corroborates the integration baseline: existing User/Address entities/services/repositories, CurrentUserIdProvider and shared errors plus V1/V2 migrations are present. No auth-domain source, session/refresh migrations or configured real authentication implementation appears in the production inventory. Current source not yet implementing the no-@ amendment is future implementation work, not a failure of the written amendment criterion. No runtime tests were run; checklist checks are not acceptance evidence for implementation, concurrency or deployment readiness.

Only auth-security.md was edited. requirements.md, source, build, databases and the reviewed requirements/contracts remain unchanged. Dependency approvals, deployment inputs and legacy-data compatibility checks remain future gates. No tasks.md exists yet.


## Current Review Disposition After Clarification (2026-10-26)

**38/38 requirements-quality criteria satisfied; zero unchecked items.** The user explicitly resolved CHK010: check both permission and ownership, using hasAuthority. Contradictory spec/contracts statements have been replaced, with matching enforcement and acceptance rules in the HTTP/domain-service contracts, plan, research and quickstart. The historical 37/38 finding above is resolved and retained only as review history.

No source code, dependency, migration or runtime test changed. requirements.md is unchanged. Checked criteria confirm written requirements quality, not implemented security or passing API acceptance.
